subject: general
question: The shape of a basketball court is a_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**rectangle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The shape of a basketball **court is a** ****rectangle**.
 
• In basketball, the basketball court serves as the playing surface, featuring a **rectangular floor with baskets **located at opposite ends. Indoor courts are typically constructed using polished wood, commonly maple, and are equipped with **10-foot-high rims** on each basket.
 
• **Outdoor courts** are usually made from standard paving materials like concrete or asphalt.
 
• Basketball courts vary in size, with different dimensions used in various leagues and levels of play.
 
• In the National Basketball Association (NBA), the court measures 94 by 50 feet (28.7 by 15.2 meters). However, under the rules of the International Basketball Federation (FIBA), the court is slightly smaller at 28 by 15 meters (91.9 by 49.2 feet).
 
• For amateur basketball, court sizes can vary widely, and many older high school gyms may have dimensions ranging from 84 feet (26 meters) to as short as 74 feet (23 meters) in length.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Soccer/Football: **Soccer fields are rectangular in shape, with a length of around 100-110 meters (110-120 yards) and a width of 64-75 meters (70-82 yards). B
 
• **Tennis: **Tennis courts are rectangular and divided into singles and doubles courts. A standard singles court measures 23.77 meters (78 feet) in length and 8.23 meters (27 feet) in width, while a doubles court is slightly wider.
 
• **Cricket:** Cricket grounds vary in size, but they are generally large grass fields with a circular or oval shape, often spanning several acres.
 
• **Baseball:** Baseball fields are diamond-shaped, with a square infield and a triangular outfield. The distance between bases is typically 90 feet (27.4 meters).
